lines.text: The disciples rebuked people bringing babies to Jesus, but Jesus called the children to Him.
Jesus said anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.
A ruler said he had kept the commandments from his youth, and Jesus told him to sell everything.
Jesus said a sheep passing through a needle's eye is easier than a rich man entering God's kingdom.
Peter said they left all, and Jesus promised many times more now and a crown of glory later.
